info.title: Carteira B3 API
info.description: API REST da Carteira B3. Erros em RFC 7807 (application/problem+json, schema ProblemDetails); decimais como string; datas ISO 8601. Rotas protegidas exigem o access token (Authorization: Bearer).

refresh_token.name: refresh_token
refresh_token.description: httpOnly refresh token cookie set by /auth/register, /auth/login and /auth/refresh (Path=/api/v1/auth).

FieldErrorCode.description: Why the field was rejected (D56): a closed list, the same on every endpoint. The client shows its own text by field + code.

min.description: TOO_SHORT, and REQUIRED of a field with a minimum length: the minimum number of characters.

max.description: TOO_LONG: the maximum number of characters. TOO_LARGE of page and pageSize: the maximum value.

maxDecimals.description: TOO_MANY_DECIMALS: the maximum number of decimal places.

maxIntegerDigits.description: TOO_LARGE of a decimal: the maximum digits before the point.

step.description: INVALID_STEP: the step, as a decimal string.

today.description: FUTURE_DATE: today in São Paulo (D54), YYYY-MM-DD.

field.description: Property path in the body or query string; nested properties use dots (address.street, items.0.quantity).

code.description: Why the field was rejected (D56): a closed list, the same on every endpoint. The client shows its own text by field + code.

message.example: password must have at least 8 characters
message.description: English, for logs and readers of the API; not meant to be shown to the user.

errors.description: 400: one entry per invalid input, from validation of the body or query and from domain rules (at most 50). 409 of a form: the conflicting field, with ALREADY_EXISTS.

field.description: 409 only: the field whose value conflicts with an existing resource (e.g. e-mail already registered); errors[] repeats it with ALREADY_EXISTS.

displayName.description: Ticker for stocks, FIIs, ETFs and BDRs; name for crypto; bond type and maturity year for fixed income (D50).

sector.description: Sector of the issuer, when it has one.

total.description: Assets matching the search, across all pages.

cnpj.description: 14 digits; null for an exchange without CNPJ (D50).

operationCount.description: Operations of the portfolio, counted in the query (D41). Shown when confirming the deletion: they go with it.

lastTradeDate.description: Trade date of the most recent operation (header "9 operações · última em 28/10/2026"); null without operations.

assetCount.description: Assets with an open position (quantity > 0), derived from the operations by the position calculator (RN09); closed positions do not count.

name.description: RN02: unique per user (case-sensitive), trimmed, 1 to 150 characters.

displayName.description: Ticker for stocks, FIIs, ETFs and BDRs; name for crypto; bond type and maturity year for fixed income (D50).

items.description: Most recent first: trade date, then order of entry.

total.description: Operations matching the filters, across all pages.

id.description: Null only when the offending sell is the operation being created (nothing was saved).

rule.description: RN07: the operation being saved is a sell above the position at its date. RN10: the change makes a later sell exceed the position at its date.

operation.description: The offending sell (the first one, chronologically).

availableQuantity.description: Units held at the date of the offending sell, before it.

assetId.description: An active asset of the catalog (C1).

tradeDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, not after today in São Paulo (RN04, D54).

quantity.description: Greater than zero (RN04): whole units for stocks, FIIs, ETFs and BDRs; multiples of 0.01 for fixed income; up to 8 decimal places for crypto; at most 12 digits before the point.

unitPrice.description: Greater than zero, up to 8 decimal places, at most 12 digits before the point.

fees.description: Brokerage and fees of the note: zero or more, up to 2 decimal places.
